mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime that raises real interest rates and reduces present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a contraction in aggregate demand that reduces corporate earnings expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) when GDPC1 YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and input costs, compressing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) during periods when UNRATE > 6% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE and a fall in PAYEMS over one month indicates labor market imbalances that depress corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > previous month AND PAYEMS < previous month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO below -1% for four consecutive months signals weakening industrial production and reduced corporate revenue prospects, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) when INDPRO < -1% for four months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in HOUST and a fall in RSAFS in the same month signals weakening housing demand despite higher housing starts, which typically precedes declines in consumer confidence and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month AND RSAFS < previous month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) when HOUST rises and RSAFS falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent FEDFUNDS rate below 1% for more than one year signals an extended period of monetary accommodation that elevates risk asset valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.05 mean excess return) when FEDFUNDS < 1% for over a year.

mechanism_narrative: A YoY increase in GDPC1 above 4% combined with a concurrent rise in CPIAUCSL above 3% signals an inflationary growth environment that erodes real corporate earnings and increases discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) when GDPC1 YoY > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.
